column1: # repeat_compare manifest v2: tab-separated, header-driven (column order is free).
# One row per assembly ("sample"); "#" lines and blank lines are ignored.
# Every cell needs a value, no spaces: write NA / . / unknown for "not known".
#   sample_id      short code, [A-Za-z0-9]+, unique; wildcard and library-name prefix (e.g. ind6)
#   taxon          species name, [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ (e.g. Sturnella_neglecta); samples of one
#                  species share it (cross-taxon cluster counts, satellite cross-check inference)
#   taxid          NCBI taxonomy id, or NA
#   fasta          absolute path to the assembly FASTA (may be gzipped)
#   sex            ZW | ZZ | XX | XY | unknown  (W/Y-linked repeats differ by sex)
#   assembly_type  haploid | primary | hap1 | hap2 | dual_hap | unknown
#                  dual_hap = both haplotypes in one assembly (e.g. unphased Verkko):
#                  absolute copy-number thresholds are doubled for it
#   accession      metadata only (never downloaded), or NA
# This file is an EXAMPLE with placeholder paths.
